<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/cluster-capi-operator/pull/625):

>https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/OCPCLOUD-3366
>
>Implement switch-based validation for the `CRDData.Type` field across all consumption points to ensure forward compatibility. When new type values are added in the future, older controllers will return clear error messages instead of attempting to parse non-YAML data with the YAML parser.
>
>Changes:
>- Add Type validation switch statements in 5 consumption points:
>  * Admission webhook (`crdcompatibility_webhook.go`)
>  * CRD validator webhook (`crdvalidator_webhook.go`)
>  * Reconciler (`reconcile.go`)
>  * Object validation webhook (`objectvalidation/webhook.go`)
>  * Object pruning webhook (`objectpruning/webhook.go`)
>- Use static error variables following codebase patterns (no dynamic errors)
>- Extract complex logic into helper function to avoid cognitive complexity
>- Add comprehensive unit tests for unsupported type scenarios
>
>All switches explicitly handle `CRDDataTypeYAML` case and return descriptive errors for unsupported types.

`pkg/controllers/crdcompatibility/objectpruning/*`, `pkg/controllers/crdcompatibility/objectvalidation/*`|Object pruning and validation strategy creation dispatch on the CRD data type, preserving YAML handling and rejecting unsupported values with formatted errors.| |**Reconciliation CRD parsing**
`pkg/controllers/crdcompatibility/reconcile.go`|Reconciliation parses YAML CRD data and returns a terminal configuration error for unsupported types.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~20 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant CompatibilityRequirement participant AdmissionValidation participant ObjectSchemaAndStrategy participant Reconciliation CompatibilityRequirement->>AdmissionValidation: provide CRD type and data AdmissionValidation->>AdmissionValidation: accept YAML or reject unsupported type CompatibilityRequirement->>ObjectSchemaAndStrategy: provide compatibility schema ObjectSchemaAndStrategy->>ObjectSchemaAndStrategy: build schema/strategy or return error CompatibilityRequirement->>Reconciliation: provide CRD type and data Reconciliation->>Reconciliation: parse YAML or return terminal configuration error ``` **Suggested reviewers:** `racheljpg`, `mdbooth`
